name: Maxwell AFB
description: Maxwell AFB and Gunter Annex form a two-site installation in Montgomery — home of the 42nd Air Base Wing, Air University (AU), and Officer Training School (OTS). Maxwell is the Air Force's center for professional military education and doctrine; Gunter Annex (~17 miles northeast) hosts cyber and IT missions.

currentNotifications.title: Closed Base — No Visitor Control Center
currentNotifications.body: Maxwell-Gunter is a closed installation with no Visitor Control Center. All visitors must be sponsored and pre-registered through DBIDS. REAL ID required for base access.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

primaryAction.title: Maxwell AFB Newcomers & In-Processing
primaryAction.address: 50 LeMay Plaza, Bldg 804, Maxwell AFB, AL 36112

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit normal business hours (Mon-Fri 0730-1630). Attend the newcomers briefing at the M&FRC. Visit the Military Personnel Flight in Bldg 804 for ID cards and personnel actions.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Management Office before arrival. All personnel must visit HMO before signing any off-base lease. Maxwell Inns offers temporary lodging — book early during PME and OTS seasons.

sections.title: Gate Access & Two-Site Installation
sections.body: Maxwell Blvd and Gunter Dickerson gates are open 24/7. Kelly St is Mon-Fri 0600-1800. Day St and Dalraida gates are closed. Maxwell-Gunter is a closed base with no Visitor Control Center — all visitors must be sponsored via DBIDS. Maxwell AFB and Gunter Annex are ~17 miles apart; confirm your duty location before signing a lease.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus Life at the Max for MWR, dining, and recreation at both Maxwell and Gunter.
